title: Root Equals Sum of Children
summary: Given a binary tree with exactly three nodes: a root and its left and right children, determine if the root's value is equal to the sum of the values of its left and right children.
statement: Given a binary tree with exactly three nodes: a root and its left and right children, determine if the root's value is equal to the sum of the values of its left and right children. Return true if the condition is met, or false otherwise.

Return whether root.val equals left.val plus right.val.
